# Cameron Cooper

> Senior DevSecOps Engineer II at Wellthy. Cloud security automation, compliance engineering, and team enablement for a healthcare caregiver platform.

Cameron Cooper is a DevSecOps engineer based in Huntington Beach, CA, with 7+ years securing SaaS platforms across healthcare, enterprise, and defense. He leads cloud security and compliance engineering at Wellthy, previously worked at CVS Health / Aetna Health and Parsons, and is the author of "Breaking into DevSecOps."

## Key facts

- Current role: Senior DevSecOps Engineer II (Lead) at Wellthy, January 2022 — Present
- Maintains a 0-day Mean Time to Remediation (MTTR) for critical and high-severity vulnerabilities across 7+ engineering teams
- Architected an AI-powered vulnerability remediation system using the Claude API and CircleCI
- Led multiple SOC 2 Type II audits and HIPAA/NIST/GDPR compliance programs
- Author of "Breaking into DevSecOps: A Practical Guide for Launching Your Career in Secure Software Delivery"
